record_title: Sharp Assouad-dimension ceiling from uniform disconnectedness on the line
limitations: The sharp formula is proved for subsets of the real line and uses one-dimensional order; no same-constant higher-dimensional analogue is claimed. Assouad dimension below one does not by itself give a quantitative lower bound for the optimal uniform-disconnectedness or Stieltjes jump-dominance constant. The central-Cantor examples establish sharpness but not uniqueness of extremizers. The motivating preprint is very recent, and unindexed parallel work remains possible.
